newsitem.title: USA: Wolf Creek, Kan., power plant seen back Sat.-Sun.
newsitem.headline: Wolf Creek, Kan., power plant seen back Sat.-Sun.

text.p: Wolf Creek Nuclear Operating Corp said Wednesday it expects to restart its 1,200 megawatt (MW) Wolf Creek nuclear power station some time this weekend.
"Our target time is to resume production this weekend," said Cathy Autrey, a company spokeswoman.
The plant, near Burlington, Kan., was manually shut Tuesday afternoon to repair a steam leak.
The facility is about 90 miles southwest of Kansas City.
The plant had been operating at full power just before it was shut down.
The unit's reactor is active and being kept in "hot standby", which typically indicates a prompt restart is expected.
Wolf Creek Nuclear Operating Corp is owned 47 percent by Kansas City Power and Light and 47 percent by Kansas Gas and Electric Co, a subsidiary of Western Resources Inc .
The rest is owned by local power cooperatives.
